text:
You need a backend that lets users browse legal documents and generate customized drafts through your existing front-end, and I can build that quickly.  

I’m Noor Halden, with 6 years of experience in Python and machine learning, and I’ve built AI assistants that integrate cleanly with production systems. At Parcelwise Logistics, I created a WhatsApp and SMS delivery support chatbot using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, and FastAPI; it resolved 43% of conversations without an agent. I also built an on-premise private wiki question-answering system for Strata Engineering Group using Python, FastAPI, LlamaIndex, Qdrant, Ollama, and Llama 3, achieving an 82% top-3 hit rate on engineer questions.  

For your project, I can focus on robust backend logic, AI integration, and seamless front-end connectivity.
